description: This Swift source file defines a class named 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' that monitors file system events using the FSEventStream API. It handles starting and stopping the watcher, coalescing rapid events to prevent redundant callbacks, and executing a provided callback upon detected changes.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A Swift class that watches for file system changes on specified paths, with event coalescing to reduce redundant notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' with specified paths, queue label, coalescing delay, notification condition, and change handler.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the watcher, ensuring it is stopped and resources are released.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event stream listener.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event stream and releases resources.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming file system events, applies filtering, and schedules the 'onChange' callback with event coalescing.
